name: git-graph-rs-backend
description: This plugin folder's own metadata — not the packaged extension's manifest. Unlike plugins/ggs-ext-demo (self-contained), git-graph-rs.ggx's real id/version/displayName/contributes come from the vscode-git-graph-rs submodule's own package.json; build.mjs reads that, not this file. This one only documents the backend build.mjs compiles and packs (src/main.rs, Cargo's git-graph-backend [[bin]], the engine feature).
